name: The Good Life Dog Rescue
notes: Formed when Rescuzilla and Bully Project NYC merged. A volunteer-run, foster-based dog rescue with no shelter building, for the New York City metro area, including pit bulls and other bully breeds; Bully Project NYC worked against dogfighting in the city. Start with the adoption or foster questionnaire on its site, or email hello@thegldr.org. Mailing address: 178 Columbus Ave, PO Box #230090, New York, NY 10023 (not a place to visit). No public phone.
